content:
Hannah (Finance): FYI Azure Marketplace invoice A-MP-2028-03 shows a pricing tier mismatch for reseller BrightWave — they were billed at list price + partner surcharge and also the partner surcharge repeated as a separate line. Potential double-bill.
Marco (Billing Ops): Can you paste the lines?
Hannah (Finance): Snippet: 
```
line 12: RWINF-PRO-TIER qty 10 $9,000
line 13: BRIGHTWAVE-SURCHARGE qty 10 $900
line 14: BRIGHTWAVE-SURCHARGE qty 10 $900
```
Tess (Partner Success): Ouch. BrightWave opened a ticket. They say their statement shows only one surcharge but the marketplace invoice duplicates it, so payout is wrong.
Azure-billing-bot: Marketplace invoice A-MP-2028-03 posted 2028-03-09T11:22:10Z.
Marco (Billing Ops): Likely cause: transform rule duplicated when the surcharge mapping was added to both tier_transform and partner_transform in the pipeline on 2028-03-07. I'll investigate.
Arjun (Revenue): Estimate exposure?
Hannah (Finance): Quick scan -> 4 impacted reseller invoices, total duplicate amount $2,700; BrightWave $1,800. All under our $5k auto-approve threshold.
Tess (Partner Success): BrightWave wants a corrected payout this week. I can ask them to accept a credit memo and immediate payout.
Marco (Billing Ops): Plan: 1) rollback pipeline change for partner_transform; 2) regenerate partner statements for affected resellers; 3) issue credit memos and process immediate payouts for amounts < $5k. I'll open Azure support case if we see ledger issues.
Hannah (Finance): Approve credits <= $5k. No need to escalate to FP&A. Please upload the CSV of impacted invoices.
Tess (Partner Success): I'll get partner ack and preference for payout vs. invoice correction.
Marco (Billing Ops): CSV uploaded: https://redwood.app/sheets/azure-dup-surcharge-2028 sheet "duplicates-mar". Columns: reseller_id, invoice_id, line_id, amount, action.
Azure-billing-bot: Support case opened: AZ-555-2028.
Arjun (Revenue): Record provisional payouts as contra-revenue entries. Keep notes for reversal if Azure can void duplicate lines.
Hannah (Finance): Action items -> @Marco fix pipeline + CSV, @Tess get partner ack, @Hannah prepare credit memos. Marking P1 until payouts complete.
Marco (Billing Ops): ETA rollback + regen statements: 3 hours. Will post smoke test results here.
Tess (Partner Success): BrightWave acknowledged and requested payout first. I'll attach signed acceptance when done.
Hannah (Finance): Thanks — short updates only in this thread to keep audit trail. :white_check_mark:
